about: What the best of the field does for each thing the kit does, how the kit compares, and the tests that prove it. docs/benchmarks.md says how this is used; scripts/benchmarks.js holds it to that.

leaders.does: Shift for finer resolution while dragging, type a value with the digits, Delete or double-click for the default, Enter and Esc to confirm or cancel
Double-click text entry of parameter values

entries.ours: Drag the number or its line; Shift for a tenth the speed, or always fine by preference; wheel and arrows by a step; double-click the number or press Enter to type, with units and k understood; a digit starts a value with no click; Delete or a double-click on the line for the default; the range and the default are shown while it is held.
proof: a slide along a value is one gesture for the host
a value can be typed, and nonsense leaves it alone
a typed value is read the way a person writes one
a digit starts a value with no click first, and Delete is the default
a setting held is purple, with its range, until it is let go

entries.what: What a right-click on a setting offers

leaders.does: Copy and paste of bands and presets, also between instances
A context menu on every parameter with its automation and mapping commands

entries.ours: Type a value, return to the default (named), copy, paste, lock against presets. No automation or mapping commands: those are the host's here.
proof: a value's menu resets, copies, pastes and locks

entries.what: Binding a hardware control to a setting from inside the plugin

leaders.does: MIDI Learn associates any MIDI controller with any parameter

entries.gap: The kit does not pass controllers to the page or map them.
entries.next: Controller messages through the bridge, then "Learn" in a value's menu.

entries.what: Recovering from a change, and hearing two versions

leaders.does: Undo, redo and A/B comparison in the plugin

entries.ours: Undo and redo by button and by Ctrl+Z, each step a proper gesture for the host; a preset loaded is one step; A and B, where B starts as a copy of A. Both are forgotten when the editor closes.
proof: undo and redo step through the page's own changes
compare flips between two sets of settings
a preset loaded is one step to undo
a preset loads as one step, names itself, and undoes as one

entries.what: Finding, trying, keeping and sharing sounds

leaders.does: A preset system in every plugin, with copy and paste of presets between instances

entries.ours: A browser over the sheet: search, the plugin's own and one's own, a four-bar picture of each, hear one by pointing at it, press to keep it, save and delete one's own, lock a setting against them. Better at telling presets apart and trying them; worse at keeping them.
entries.gap: One's own presets live in the editor's storage: they are not files, do not travel between machines, and the host's own preset list does not see them.
entries.next: Presets as files through the bridge, and the factory ones in the host's program list.
proof: a preset names settings in their own terms and leaves the rest
pointing at a preset tries it, and leaving puts things back
a preset of one's own is saved, kept, found and deleted

entries.what: Learning what a control does without a manual

leaders.does: Interactive help hints, and an extensive help file

entries.ours: The foot of the sheet names and explains whatever is under the pointer or has the keyboard; with help on it adds the range and the resting place, and names are marked as readable.
proof: the foot of the sheet says what the pointer is over
with help on, the foot says a setting's range and resting place
help adds a setting's range and where it rests

entries.what: Being the right size on any screen

leaders.does: A resize button for interface size and scaling, and a full screen mode

entries.ours: The whole page scales in proportion to the window the host gives it; three densities trade the size of the numbers for room on the glass. No full screen.
proof: the page scales whole to its window, in proportion
density steps through three, shrinks the numbers and is remembered
nothing on the page runs past its edge

entries.what: Knowing how loud it is, and whether it clipped

leaders.does: A large output level meter with a peak level readout

entries.ours: The number is the peak. Six segments break at -24, -12, -6, -3 and 0 dB with the top of the scale stretched; colour by zone; a clip lamp that stays lit until clicked; the hold is the person's to choose.
proof: a level fills six segments, breaking at -24, -12, -6, -3 and 0 dB
a level is named for the segment it has reached
a clip lights a lamp that stays lit until clicked
a meter holds its peak for a moment, then lets go

entries.what: Seeing what the plugin is doing to the sound

leaders.does: An interactive display that fills the window: bands are made and adjusted on it with the mouse, over a live spectrum

entries.ours: A glass a plugin draws on, redrawn as settings and meters move, purple where the held setting shapes it. It shows what the plugin would do, from its settings and levels.
entries.gap: No live signal reaches the page, and the picture is not itself dragged.
entries.next: A signal channel from the audio thread to the page; then handles on the picture, starting with the equaliser on the canvas.
proof: the picture is drawn, and drawn again when a setting moves

entries.what: Hearing the sound without the plugin, from the plugin

leaders.does: A global bypass in the bottom bar that avoids clicks

entries.ours: An On button in the header when the spec has a setting keyed "bypass": filled when on, and the glass dims when bypassed.
entries.gap: The kit does not provide the setting, mark it as the host's bypass, or crossfade it.
entries.next: A bypass in kit-core that both formats flag as theirs, faded in the runner.
proof: the plugin's own bypass is one press, and says which it is

entries.what: Suiting the room and the eyes

leaders.does: Light and dark themes for the whole application, which can follow the system

entries.ours: A light and a dark theme, switched in the header or in settings, able to follow the system, kept for every editor of ours. Every control is looked at in both.
proof: the theme switch flips the page and is remembered
the theme is the one chosen before, else the system's
settings are chosen in a panel and kept for every editor

leaders.does: Shape and slope chosen from buttons and drop-downs beside the band

entries.ours: Pills, the chosen one filled in, each a full-size target.
proof: a click, a key and a double-click are gestures too

entries.what: Choosing one of many, and on or off

leaders.does: Choosers that open a list in the application's own style, and toggles that say their state

entries.ours: A native select written large, and a switch with its state in words.
entries.gap: The menu opens the system's list, not one in the house style, and neither has a test or a picture of its own.
entries.next: The list drawn as on the canvas ("A choice of many"), with tests and a gallery scene for both.

leaders.does: Tabs for oscillators, effects, matrix and global, one shown at a time

entries.ours: A tab a group, each tab a small live chart of its values, so what is on another tab is still in view.
proof: groups show one at a time, and every group's values in its tab

entries.what: A level that is ridden, not set

leaders.does: Mixer faders with the meter beside the cap and the value typed below

entries.ours: A fader whose cap carries the number, and one whose line is the meter it sets.
proof: a fader is dragged up and down, as one gesture

leaders.does: A band dragged by either edge or whole by its middle; stereo link as an amount

entries.ours: Linked (the gap kept, and a link to let go), mirrored, opposed (one line shared), and a span dragged by either end or its middle. Both settings are one gesture.
proof: a pair moves together, apart, or one against the other
opposed settings trade: what one gains the other gives up
linked settings keep their gap, until the link is let go
a span moves by either end, or whole by its middle

entries.what: Two settings played with one hand

leaders.does: XY pads on devices, with each axis an ordinary parameter

entries.ours: A pad whose point is two ordinary settings; their numbers move as it does.
proof: the pad moves two settings with one point

entries.what: Saying what happened and what to do

leaders.does: Plain dialogs for missing or newer presets

entries.ours: A notice on the glass: what happened, what it means for the sound, and the ways out.
entries.gap: It is drawn, but nothing in the kit raises one yet: an unknown preset key is dropped in silence.
entries.next: Raise it from the preset loader and from a missing input.
